title: A Crown for the Oath
author: Gideon Nystrom
blurb: Wren Galloway, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
